prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1031; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center with the left tail lamp housing broken, and the trunk lid shows a dented edge with paint transfer consistent with the reported impact. The damage pattern lines up with the collision as described. Repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp assembly, repairing the trunk lid, and refinishing the rear panel. Labor hours look a little high for this scope and should be reviewed against the standard guide. A few older scratches on the lower quarter panel may predate this loss and are noted separately. Two similar charges posted on the same day are currently under review before approval.
